question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_views AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, ph.page_name, ph.product_category, COUNT(*) as views
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sce.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND sce.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.page_name, ph.product_category
),
product_adds AS (
    SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(*) as added_to_cart
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sce.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND sce.event_type = 2
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
visit_products_added AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sce.visit_id, ph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sce.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) AND sce.event_type = 2
),
visited_with_purchase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sce.visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    WHERE sce.page_id = 13 AND sce.event_type = 3
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT vpa.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT vpa.visit_id) as purchases
    FROM visit_products_added vpa
    JOIN visited_with_purchase vwp ON vpa.visit_id = vwp.visit_id
    GROUP BY vpa.product_id
)
SELECT 
    pv.page_name as product,
    pv.product_category,
    pv.views,
    pa.added_to_cart,
    pa.added_to_cart - pp.purchases as left_in_cart,
    pp.purchases as purchases
FROM product_views pv
JOIN product_adds pa ON pv.product_id = pa.product_id
JOIN product_purchases pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pv.product_id
